purpose: Find the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of a compound against a bacterial strain: 2-fold serial dilution in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth, a standard inoculum added 1:1, overnight growth, turbidity read. A non-kinase negative control for routing.
notes: 463100 and 624097 are checkerboard synergy assays (compound x imipenem); only their shared broth-microdilution conditions (medium, inoculum, volume, incubation, readout) are used here.
Three of the four AIDs are from one Scripps project (metallo-beta-lactamase inhibitors). PubChem 'Activity outcome method' is 'Other' for 449774, 463100, 624097 and 'Confirmatory' for 1503.

The Opentrons exemplar is on the main branch, not this one: Opentrons/MIC_2Fold_Dilution_1Antibiotic_1Strain_200uL_modified.py. Its write-up (.docx) names both CAMHB and 'regular M9 broth' for the broth; the script's liquid label says CAMHB.
Inoculum: each source adds about 1e6 CFU/mL in an equal volume, so wells start near 5e5 CFU/mL (derived).

steps.text: Prepare cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth (CAMHB) and the compound at 2x the top concentration.

evidence.quote: Imipenem or test compound was titrated in Cation Adjusted Mueller-Hinton Broth (CAMHB) immediately prior to testing.

steps.text: Make a 2-fold, 10-point dilution series in broth across the plate.

evidence.quote: Step 4: serial dilution, column 1 -> 10, then discard 100 uL from column 10

steps.text: Grow the strain to log phase and dilute it in broth to the inoculum density (2x final).

evidence.quote: E. coli previously grown in CAMHB to log phase OD600 of 0.5 - 0.7

steps.text: Add an equal volume of inoculum to every well except the sterility control.

evidence.quote: Next, 30 uL of CAMHB inoculated with BL21 wild type E.coli 1 x 106 CFU/mL was added to wells.
Step 5: 100 uL bacteria into columns 1-11, fresh tip each column

steps.text: Mix each well after adding the inoculum.

evidence.quote: incubated for 18 hours at 37 C in a humidified environment

steps.text: Read turbidity (OD590 / OD530) or score visible growth; MIC = lowest concentration with no growth.

evidence.quote: Absorbance (OD590) was read on a Tecan Spectraflour Plus plate reader
Optical density at 530 nm was measured

controls.name: growth control: bacteria in broth, no compound

evidence.quote: High_Control is defined as wells containing BL21 E.coli.

controls.name: sterility control: broth only, no bacteria

evidence.quote: High_Control is defined as wells containing media only (no bacteria).

controls.name: reference antibiotic at an inhibitory concentration (imipenem 50 uM)

evidence.quote: Low_Control is defined as wells containing Imipenem (50 uM).

analysis.text: MIC = the lowest concentration whose signal falls below the no-growth cutoff (mean + 3 SD of the inhibited controls), or by CLSI visual reading.

evidence.quote: The reported MIC values were generated by identifying the lowest concentration of inhibitor that yields a value that is less than the cutoff value.
The MIC was read as the concentration producing a greater than 2-fold reduction in growth
